article.hook: You’re in three conversations at once but can’t finish any. Mars in Gemini scrambles your focus - your mind and mouth race before your hands can catch up.
article.lived: Over the next six weeks, you’ll find yourself juggling questions, rebuttals, and new ideas like ping-pong balls. The email you meant to send yesterday waits while you chase a thread on social media or rehearse a point out loud. You keep the calendar packed and the messages flowing, restless to know more and say more, always on the move mentally and verbally.
article.turn: Speed becomes scatter. You argue for the sake of arguing, switch topics mid-sentence, and leave others wondering where you landed. You start too many things and finish too few. When your brain pushes faster than your follow-through, the noise drowns out your point. Say what matters and drop what doesn’t.
moves: Write a question that needs an answer and actually send it this week.
Close one tab or conversation before opening another.
Repeat back what someone just said before jumping in again.
